record.question: A cube has six different symbols drawn over its six faces. The symbols are star, circle, triangle, rectangle, cross and arrow. Three different positions of the cube are shown in the three given figures. Which symbol is opposite to the rectangle?
record.explanation: The views show triangle adjacent to star,circle,rectangle,cross, so its opposite is arrow. Cross is adjacent to rectangle,triangle,arrow,circle, so its opposite is star. The two remaining faces, rectangle and circle, are opposite. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
